topics.name: commit
topics.title: Committing and pushing
rules: core/domains/technical.md § Agent attribution lives in the BODY — the author field is one shared identity
core/domains/technical.md § A push follows a commit only when HEAD MOVED
core/domains/technical.md § Cite a STABLE identifier — a branch tip is not one
core/domains/technical.md § Never write a closing keyword next to an issue reference, even to deny it

topics.name: branching
topics.title: Branches, pull requests and merging
topics.when: Opening, holding, claiming or merging a pull request.
rules: core/domains/technical.md § "Read the integration branch, never compute it" — the read returns a LIST, and selecting from it is the hard half
core/domains/technical.md § A hold on a pull request lives in the forge's own WIP / draft gate — never only in a comment
core/domains/technical.md § A merge-ready claim covers EVERY CI run for the head, queried by the full id
core/domains/technical.md § To see what a merge brings, use THREE-dot or test-merge it — two-dot answers a different question
core/domains/technical.md § In a checkout several seats share, delete only the branches you own — containment never proves abandonment
core/domains/technical.md § A branch is archived only with proof its content landed, or a ticket that will land it

topics.name: testing
topics.title: Writing and trusting tests and CI
topics.when: Writing a test, or trusting a CI result.
rules: core/domains/technical.md § A green run proves only the steps that EXECUTED in it
core/domains/technical.md § A single red is a HYPOTHESIS, not a baseline
core/domains/technical.md § A test double must FAIL the way the real collaborator fails
core/domains/technical.md § An expected value copied from the OUTPUT pins the defect
core/domains/technical.md § A fixture that cannot EXPRESS the failure certifies it clean
core/domains/technical.md § Prove a job you just kicked RAN by the output's IDENTITY, not by its timestamp

rules: core/domains/security.md § Secrets in code (mandatory)
core/domains/security.md § The BLIND PIPELINE — and it binds the hand-off blocks you author
core/domains/security.md § Ask-once provisioning
core/domains/security.md § Rotation is a routine, not a ceremony
core/domains/security.md § Found a hardcoded secret — rotation order matters

rules: core/domains/security.md § A step handed to a human must be READABLE by the human who runs it
core/domains/operations.md § Hand the human a SCRIPT, not steps — self-logging by design
core/domains/operations.md § Four tests a hand-off block must pass before the human sees it
core/domains/operations.md § An ask parked on a human names its GATE and what the answer CAUSES

topics.when: Changing infrastructure, releasing, or claiming something is deployed.

core/domains/technical.md § Tofu plan/apply split — agent plans, human applies the planfile
core/domains/technical.md § Deploys & health — pull-based

core/domains/technical.md § A deploy trigger's exit code is not the deploy's outcome — observe the served version, then record
core/domains/technical.md § Definition of done: a service isn't deployed until its backups are PROVEN

topics.when: Reviewing access, identity, or anything exposed to a network.
rules: core/domains/security.md § Security review: identify → ticket → hand off
core/domains/security.md § A ceiling is only as good as its WIDEST path — and the widest one carries METADATA
core/domains/security.md § A control is not designed until you have asked what its DEPLOYMENT exposes
core/domains/security.md § A gate keyed on a NAMED object refuses to build when that object does not exist
core/domains/security.md § A redirect URI's wildcard must never be able to reach the authority

core/domains/operations.md § Refuse to write a RATIONALE you have not measured, even when the CONCLUSION is right
core/domains/operations.md § A record's coverage ends at its LAST CITED EVENT, not at when it was WRITTEN

topics.when: Planning a change, or deciding what done means.

core/domains/technical.md § Simplest thing that works — last responsible moment
core/domains/technical.md § A done-when names the COMMITTED SURFACE that takes its receipt
core/domains/operations.md § Reproduce a bug before fixing it, on the current code, and record it on the ticket
core/domains/operations.md § "Verified" for a user-visible outcome means OBSERVED on the user's surface

core/domains/operations.md § An ask about a system another agent owns is ROUTED, not worked

core/domains/technical.md § Agents that share a scratch directory write unique paths, and a publish step proves the file is its own
